risks.proof: Photo or seller statement of original IBC labeling/manufacture plate showing prior contents, plus interior photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as unsuitable for potable water, usable only for non-drinking storage

risks.risk: Tap/valve functionality and leak-tightness cannot be confirmed from a static photo
risks.proof: Short video of the valve being opened and water flowing without leaks at the seams or cage joints

risks.risk: Exact capacity of the tote is not legible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the capacity/volume marking plate on the tote
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest common IBC size as worst case

risks.risk: Unclear which specific item among the yard stock (IBC tote, black Geepee tanks, or corrugated tank) is the one actually for sale
risks.proof: A photo of only the item for sale, isolated, with the seller confirming which one
risks.if_unproven: priced only as the IBC tote in focus, other items excluded

risks.risk: Cage frame condition (rust, bent bars, structural integrity) not clearly visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full metal cage, especially corners and base
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a rusted/compromised cage

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the capacity/volume plate on the tote
Video of the tap being opened to show water flow and no leaks
Confirmation and a dedicated photo of exactly which item (tote only, or also the black tanks/corrugated tank) is included in the sale
Photo showing prior contents/labeling history of the IBC tote if available
response.reason: The item in focus is identifiable by type as a used IBC water tote, but functionality, capacity, and prior contents are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
